why_this_packet_exists: F795 freezes the larger top-boundary semantic-role target but still leaves open whether the F704 maximum can count as a reference-scale point.
P796 shows that no current strict-side export already supplies that upgrade.

target_object.goal: Freeze the exact reference-scale-point object still missing before the F704 maximum can count as more than a numeric extremum on the alpha_s lane.

required_fields.name: candidate_family_domain_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to one explicit finite alpha_s family domain; silent domain drift is forbidden.

required_fields.name: supporting_strict_source_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to the strict-side source object that supports the extremum numerically without pretending that this already fixes its reference-scale role.

required_fields.name: numeric_extremum_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must identify the concrete exported extremum candidate, including the current F704 maximum, explicitly.

required_fields.name: reference_scale_point_rule_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must export the rule upgrading that extremum into a strict reference-scale point without importing GeV, host identification, or external policy semantics.

required_fields.name: nonstrict_calibration_exclusion_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly fence off the proxy-to-GeV calibration lane from supplying the reference-scale role.

required_fields.name: selected_reference_point_output_schema
required_fields.hard_limit: Must output the admitted reference-scale point and its role inside the selected normalized family schema.

required_fields.name: hard_limits
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly deny Standard Model identification, QCD closure, and ToE closure.

current_honest_reading: The current sharp blocker is no longer whether the point 1 exists or whether the top of the F704 spectrum is numerically defined.
It is the missing rule that would upgrade that extremum into a strict reference-scale point.
F796 freezes that exact missing object without promoting the current family winner.
recommended_next_move: Build one narrow probe testing whether any current strict-side invariant or theorem can justify treating the exported F704 maximum as a reference-scale point rather than only as the largest current proxy value.
hard_limits: Does not claim that the reference-scale point already exists.
Does not claim that f704_max_mode_anchor_family is already promoted.
Does not claim alpha_s boundary export readiness.
